entries.label: Immune Engineering
entries.quote: Genetically engineered immune cells are saving the lives of cancer patients. That may be just the start.
entries.note: Breakthrough field: "Killer T cells programmed to wipe out cancer."

entries.label: Precise Gene Editing in Plants
key_players: Institute of Genetics and Developmental Biology, Beijing
entries.quote: CRISPR offers an easy, exact way to alter genes to create traits such as disease resistance and drought tolerance.

entries.label: Conversational Interfaces
entries.quote: Powerful speech technology from China's leading Internet company makes it much easier to use a smartphone.

entries.label: Reusable Rockets
entries.quote: Rockets typically are destroyed on their maiden voyage. But now they can make an upright landing and be refueled for another trip, setting the stage for a new era in spaceflight.

entries.label: Robots That Teach Each Other
entries.quote: What if robots could figure out more things on their own and share that knowledge among themselves?

entries.label: DNA App Store
entries.quote: An online store for information about your genes will make it cheap and easy to learn more about your health risks and predispositions.

entries.label: SolarCity's Gigafactory
entries.quote: A $750 million solar facility in Buffalo will produce a gigawatt of high-efficiency solar panels per year and make the technology far more attractive to homeowners.

entries.label: Slack
entries.quote: A service built for the era of mobile phones and short text messages is changing the workplace.

entries.label: Tesla Autopilot
entries.quote: The electric-vehicle maker sent its cars a software update that suddenly made autonomous driving a reality.

entries.label: Power from the Air
entries.quote: Internet devices powered by Wi-Fi and other telecommunications signals will make small computers and sensors more pervasive.

notes: Ten entries. Web date 2016-02-23. Each web article has Breakthrough / Why It Matters / Key Players fields; no Availability field found on the web articles. Quote is the article dek. Person names dropped from key players. Read through a summarising fetch per article; medium confidence.
